scope: DXF SUNSTUDY object record identity remapping, allocation, binding and transactional retry.

source_context.schema: DXF group 5 is the record's object identity; the SUNSTUDY reference fields 340-343 carry separate relationships to page setup, VIEW, visual style and text style records.
source_context.implementation_gap: dxfRW::writeSunStudy already resolved its four typed references but emitted ent->handle verbatim and did not reserve or bind the output object identity.

implementation.behavior: A supplied source identity is remapped, checked against invalid and fixed output handles, reserved, emitted as group 5, and bound to the emitted object identity after record serialization. A zero/no-source identity is allocated before record emission. RecordStateScope and DxfWriterRecordScope protect source bindings and bytes.
implementation.reference_policy: Resolver-first handling remains limited to the four typed reference edges; the object's own group-5 identity follows the explicit source-handle remap independently.
implementation.failure_behavior: A late invalid EED value leaves earlier destination bytes unchanged and publishes no source identity binding. A corrected fresh writer emits and binds the remapped identity.

validation.input: Generated in-memory records only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: the source SUNSTUDY identity remaps independently from resolver/remap selection for reference groups 340-343
a second SUNSTUDY without a source identity receives an allocated and read-back group-5 handle
late invalid EED rolls back record bytes and leaves no source identity binding
corrected fresh-writer retry emits and binds the remapped group-5 identity
unresolved typed references preserve the destination and corrected fresh-writer retries still pass

qualification_limits: Generated controls do not establish complete physical SUNSTUDY producer coverage or source graph closure.
No independent native consumer or plotting semantics were validated.
This transport fix does not promote SUNSTUDY or rendering support claims.
